about_the_game:
The Sasuke Uchiha Starter Pack includes the following content:
- Master Character Training Pack - Sasuke Uchiha (BORUTO)
- Master Character Training Pack - Sasuke Uchiha (Last Battle)
- Master Character Training Pack - Sasuke Uchiha (Young Ver. Final Battle)
- Top Secret Training Set - Sasuke Uchiha
- Moonlight Scroll x10

Introducing a Starter Pack containing 3 different versions of Sasuke!
The Top Secret Training Set immediately unlocks all 3 Master Characters' ninjutsu, costumes, and other rewards!

Moonlight Scrolls can be appraised at the Ninja Tools Shop to unlock new costumes, weapons, ninja tools, and more!

*Includes products that are also sold individually. Be careful of duplicate purchases.
*Once you purchase the bundle, items can be claimed from the Gift Box at the Inn.
*Moonlight Scroll x10 will be automatically received in-game. Moonlight Scrolls are consumable items and will be used via the in-game Appraisal feature.
